live_monitoring_contract.description: Schema contract for a live monitoring record. Each record represents one strategy prediction evaluated against a real draw result captured after P144B monitoring is activated.

fields.prediction_generated_at: TEXT — ISO timestamp when prediction was generated
fields.draw_result_available_at: TEXT — ISO timestamp when draw result was confirmed
fields.predicted_numbers: TEXT — JSON array of predicted numbers
fields.actual_numbers: TEXT — JSON array of actual draw numbers
fields.source_trace: TEXT — traceability key linking to prediction log entry
fields.monitoring_truth_level: TEXT — truth level label for live monitoring rows
fields.created_at: TEXT — ISO timestamp when monitoring record was created

live_monitoring_contract.note: Live monitoring rows use truth_level='LIVE_MONITORING_VERIFIED'. They are distinct from historical backfill rows and from LEGACY_UNVERIFIED rows. No live monitoring rows exist in the DB at P144B creation time.

historical_vs_live_data_boundary.explanation: Historical backfill rows have actual_numbers populated because the replay process runs against known historical draws. This is NOT live monitoring evidence. Live evidence is defined as: predictions generated BEFORE a draw, subsequently compared against the REAL draw result in a post-draw evaluation run. No such runs have occurred for any Wave 2 strategy. champion_eval_ready_from_live_data remains False until ≥50 live draws are evaluated per strategy with edge > baseline and perm p < 0.05.

option_a_manual_on_demand_monitoring.description: Manually generate predictions for the next draw, then run a post-draw evaluation script after results are available. No scheduler. No automated pipeline.
option_a_manual_on_demand_monitoring.pros: Fully controlled; no infrastructure setup; immediate after authorization.
option_a_manual_on_demand_monitoring.cons: Manual effort per draw; not scalable for continuous monitoring.
option_a_manual_on_demand_monitoring.when_to_use: When immediate, one-off live evaluation is desired after P145B authorization.

option_b_scheduled_monitoring_after_auth.description: Install a scheduled monitoring pipeline that automatically generates predictions before each draw and runs evaluation after draw results are available. Requires explicit scheduler authorization and infra setup.
option_b_scheduled_monitoring_after_auth.pros: Automated; consistent; suitable for production-grade champion evaluation.
option_b_scheduled_monitoring_after_auth.cons: Requires scheduler setup, infra authorization, and per-strategy production routing. Not executable in P144B without additional authorization.
option_b_scheduled_monitoring_after_auth.when_to_use: After P145B authorization + scheduler infrastructure review.

option_c_observation_only_file_artifact_.description: Produce an observation-only JSON artifact capturing the monitoring contract, readiness matrix, and activation options without any DB write, API call, or scheduler install. Suitable as the immediate next step to document intent.
option_c_observation_only_file_artifact_.pros: Clean, safe, auditable. Documents the full monitoring design without side effects. Enables stakeholder review before activation.
option_c_observation_only_file_artifact_.cons: No live evidence produced; champion evaluation still blocked.
option_c_observation_only_file_artifact_.when_to_use: Immediately, as P144B output. This is what P144B does.

authorization_phrase_templates.description: Templates for authorization phrases to be used in P145B (live monitoring activation). None of these are executed in P144B. They are reference templates only.
authorization_phrase_templates.template_activate_manual_monitoring_sing: AUTHORIZE: activate manual live draw monitoring for {strategy_id} on {lottery_type}. Generate prediction for draw {next_draw_id}. Evaluate after draw result confirmed.
authorization_phrase_templates.template_activate_scheduled_monitoring_a: AUTHORIZE: install scheduled monitoring pipeline for all 6 Wave 2 strategies. Confirm infra setup and scheduler authorization before execution.
authorization_phrase_templates.template_record_live_evaluation_result: AUTHORIZE: record live draw evaluation result for {strategy_id}, draw {target_draw}, hit_count={hit_count}, evaluation_status=EVALUATED.
authorization_phrase_templates.note: These templates are NOT executed in P144B. P145B (or an equivalent authorization gate) must be created and explicitly authorized before any live monitoring row is written to the DB.
